description: This file defines the interface for the IIpcClient class and its accessor within the Rialto client module, including methods for obtaining communication channels, creating blocking closures, and RPC controllers, along with the associated accessor class.

classes.name: IIpcClientAccessor
classes.description: Accessor class providing singleton access to the IIpcClient instance.

classes.name: IIpcClient
classes.description: Interface defining methods for IPC client communication, including obtaining channels, creating closures, and RPC controllers.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the IIpcClientAccessor.

methods.name: getIpcClient
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton IIpcClient object.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the IPC channel created by the client.

methods.name: createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates and returns a blocking closure for RPC stubs.

methods.name: createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns an RPC controller for RPC stubs.
